panels.title: Полное время анализа — p50 / p90 / p99
Топ пользователей по расходу токенов (за выбранный период)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  l.user_id AS "user_id",
  SUM(COALESCE(l.input_tokens,0) + COALESCE(l.output_tokens,0) + COALESCE(l.cached_tokens,0)) AS "всего токенов",
  SUM(COALESCE(l.input_tokens,0)) AS "input",
  SUM(COALESCE(l.output_tokens,0)) AS "output",
  SUM(COALESCE(l.cached_tokens,0)) AS "cached",
  COUNT(*) AS "вызовов",
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(l.duration_ms,0)) / 1000.0, 1) AS "ср. время, s",
  MAX(l.created_at) AS "последний вызов"
FROM meal_analysis_logs l
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at)
GROUP BY l.user_id
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15
